paragraphs: In the morning, sample according to the production plan and run replicates. At midday, review curves for suspicious batches and retest anomalies. In the afternoon, issue test reports and determine release with quality engineers. When a deviation occurs, open an investigation and trace the root cause. Before leaving, organize records and verify instrument status.

In one sentence: stop nonconforming products before they leave the factory. The work includes sampling, testing, determining conformity, investigating deviations, validating methods, and maintaining records. It combines hands-on work with analysis and forms the quality defense line.
